criteria.expectation: Report states that the Russian (ru) plural variation for cart.items.count in Localizable.xcstrings defines only one and other, missing the few and many categories required by Russian CLDR rules.
Report cites Localizable.xcstrings and the cart.items.count ru entry (with line numbers or the quoted one/other values), and ties it to the CartView.swift call site that interpolates items.count.
Report explains that counts like 2-4 and 5+ fall into other, producing a single wrong form such as '2 товаров', matching the ticket's complaint about Russian only.
Report recommends adding few and many variations to the ru entry (e.g. few 'товара', many 'товаров', other 'товара') and optionally a translator review.
Report does not flag the order.shipping ru reordering of %2$@ before %1$@ as a defect (it may note it as valid positional placeholders).
Report explicitly says it is a source-only review and that rendering on device/simulator, build-time catalog validation, and linguistic correctness of translations were not verified.
Report does not claim to have edited, built or run anything; proposed changes are described as recommendations and input files are left unmodified.

Report does not claim as a confirmed defect any missing or incorrect Russian plural categories, format specifier mismatch, or placeholder problem; ru cart.items.count is recognized as having one, few, many, other.
Report states what remains unverified from source alone, such as on-device rendering, layout/text expansion in German or Russian, and translation quality.
Any extra suggestions (e.g. more locales, comments, layout testing) are explicitly labeled optional or low priority; report does not demand rewrites of working strings.
If the order.shipping reordering is mentioned, it is treated as valid positional placeholders, not a bug.
Report does not claim to have edited, built or run anything and leaves input files unmodified.
